meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Udemy home page: countdown promo bar, hero banner, business upsells, thumbnails, prices
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, from saved DOM snapshots of udemy.com (home page) taken with headless Chrome, iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA. Chrome and the network became unavailable afterwards, so course, search and lecture pages were not loaded, and nothing was re-run after the snapshots.

Udemy serves two different front ends: the desktop UA gets a Next.js page with data-testid and data-purpose hooks, the phone UA an older page (mobile-header, marketing-hero-banner). Classes carry hashes, so rules use data-testid and data-purpose values; two use a module-name substring (_course-card_, marketing-hero-banner_...) because no attribute exists.

- **Promo bar**: section[data-testid=smart-bar-container] 1 on desktop; div[data-testid=smart-bar-fixed-height] 1 on phone (LIVE snapshot).
- **Hero banners**: section[data-purpose=hero-banner] 1 on desktop; the marketing-hero-banner-wide container 1 on phone.
- **Business upsells**: header-business 1, header-teach 1, partners-banner 1 on desktop; none on phone.
- **Thumbnails** (Show/Blur/Hide): 36 images in course cards on desktop. Phone course cards use other markup and are not covered.
- **Prices**: price-text-container 23 desktop, 3 phone. **Ratings**: rating-number 31 desktop, 7 phone, with the star masks.

The header Log in link (data-testid=header-login) is never matched. The OneTrust style consent dialog (Privacy Preference Center) was present but hidden. Not verified: logged-in views, course pages, other languages.
